name: pickup_on_collected
description: Pickup::OnCollected resolves the collected pickup node, applies the pickup effect, disables pickup interaction, removes duplicate weapon spawns when applicable, and either starts the pickup animation or removes the object immediately.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Pickup runtime/source-cluster pass; the smoke covers the no-animation removal path while animation binding behavior is held by accepted zEffect and RemoveObject dependencies.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41d0c0 validates the hit-owner resolution, pickup type id read from the pickup node name tail, spawn lookup, ApplyEffect amount dispatch, pickup flag/raycast/pick disable calls, optional objective-info and duplicate-removal branch for weapon pickups, pickup animation name lookup, immediate RemoveObject fallback, animation transform binding, callback registration, and spawn refCount update.

The native no-animation smoke verifies successful collection through ResolveOwnerFromBvolHit, status pickup ApplyEffect, pickup flag clearing/interaction disable calls, missing-animation RemoveObject fallback, and return value behavior.
